rationale: The current script keeps all recurrent tail blocks partially on from the start via tail_recur_min_gain. This edit turns the reverse-tail curriculum into a true staged activation: the deepest recurrent block ramps first, shallower tail blocks stay fully off until their stage opens, then ramp to full gain. That is a compact structural change aligned with the best known staged-recurrence motif, preserves fixed shapes and compile stability, and spends the run on recurrence scheduling rather than another small scalar sweep.
title: Zero-Start Reverse-Tail Recurrence Curriculum
